annotations.title: Pin a form's Google Drive upload folder

description: Send this form's uploads to a specific Google Drive folder. Get the id from fillo_list_drive_folders; the folder must be reachable by the connected Google account. Files already uploaded stay where they are. Needs storage:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_set_drive_folder
title: Pin a form's Google Drive upload folder
